summary: A Neighborhood Stories feature profiling three people who changed careers after 1 September 2023: accountant Sarah Jennings became a landscape artist, executive Michael Davis became a high school teacher, and nurse Robert Chen became a chef. It covers how they prepared, the financial and psychological hurdles, and a broader trend toward valuing personal fulfillment over traditional career success.
one_line: Profiles of Sarah Jennings, Michael Davis and Robert Chen, who left established careers in late 2023 for art, teaching and cooking.
key_facts: Sarah Jennings was an accountant for 15 years at a prestigious firm before quitting on October 15, 2023 to become a landscape artist.
Sarah Jennings sold her shares and downsized her lifestyle to cope with an unstable artist income.
Sarah Jennings advises career changers to "Network like your life depends on it" and took mentors, workshops and certification courses in digital illustration.
Michael Davis was a high-powered executive at a Silicon Valley tech company and switched to high school teaching in November 2023.
Michael Davis cited burnout and disillusionment with the corporate world, and took a significant pay cut from a six-figure salary.
Michael Davis eased the transition by volunteering at local schools and taking night classes in education while still employed.
Robert Chen, a former nurse, traded scrubs for a culinary apron in December 2023.
Robert Chen jumped in fully, relying on savings and new business plans, and faced loans, health inspections, marketing and retraining; his food blends medical knowledge with nutritional cooking.
Elizabeth Martin, a Chicago career counselor, noticed an uptick in clients seeking career change and says these are "thoughtful, deliberate decisions," not mid-life crises.
Elizabeth Martin believes pandemic-era introspection and the ubiquity of remote work influenced how people view their careers.
The article describes a trend in late 2023 of prioritizing personal fulfillment over traditional career success, with thousands redefining their professional lives.
